newsitem.title: FINLAND: NORDIC BANK MERGERS STILL POSSIBLE - J.WALLENBERG.
newsitem.headline: NORDIC BANK MERGERS STILL POSSIBLE - J.WALLENBERG.

text.p: Competition may lead to more Nordic banks to merge but nothing is currently in the making, Swedish SE-Banken's co-chairman Jacob Wallenberg was quoted as saying on Wednesday.
In an interview with daily Kauppalehti, he said Nordic banks may prepare for the expected EMU era through mergers, either nationally or across borders, the paper said.
"There is no need for cross-border arrangements in the Nordic countries. But if I were asked whether it could happen, my answer is that it can," he was quoted as saying.
He said he could not comment on speculation about merger talks between SE-Banken and Handelsbanken or Nordbanken "when I don't know that any such talks have been held".
"This is all pure speculation by Swedish newspapers," he was quoted as adding.
